established.label: Established
established.description: Replicated or broad evidence supports the core pattern, while ordinary boundary conditions and mechanism debates may still remain.

supported.label: Supported
supported.description: Credible evidence supports the pattern, but the scope is narrower, the literature is smaller, or important boundary conditions deserve emphasis.

mixed.label: Mixed
mixed.description: Evidence supports some versions of the claim while important measurement, magnitude, mechanism, or interpretation disputes remain.

contested.label: Contested
contested.description: The named claim or its popular causal interpretation faces substantial unresolved challenge, alternative explanations, or conflicting evidence.

domain-specific.label: Domain-specific
domain-specific.description: Evidence is concentrated in a narrow task, research program, or application domain and should not be generalized as a universal cognitive law.

concept.label: Reviewed concept
concept.description: A useful reviewed term, measurement concept, or broader construct that is not one standalone cognitive-bias mechanism.
